Intertextuality is a method, skill, or discipline and a guide for the scientific analysis of texts, especially artistic and non-artistic works, to determine the presence of influence through borrowing or dialogue; that is, the similarity in form, content, and technique between one text and another. This resemblance can be direct or involve proximity. Such interaction is also referred to as an echo. It is believed that intertextuality is among the oldest compositional techniques; however, as a critical approach, it still appears to be unfamiliar and has not been extensively addressed in the field of Kiswahili literature and art. For this reason, this article will contribute to the Kiswahili body of work dealing with criticism through the theory of intertextuality, in order to identify the intertextuality present in texts, for example in the play Our Cohesion Our Triumph. The results of the analysis have revealed a considerable presence of intertextuality connected to the author’s upbringing and development in religious (spiritual), physical (cultural and moral), social, and academic dimensions – in one way or another. It is part of these findings that constitutes this article. Therefore, this article presents the intertextuality between the selected play Our Cohesion Our Triumph and writings from sacred books, allegory in the selection and creation of characters, philosophical echoes, chapter or plot titles, and the mythology of symbols. The play employs language that is quickly and easily understood by anyone well-versed in Kiswahili. The dialogues constructed in this play evoke a variety of themes such as liberation, the role of women in society, social classes, sabotage, selfishness, intrigue, oppression, hatred, jealousy, greed, betrayal, exploitation, abuse, discrimination, transparency and truth, customs and traditions, unity and solidarity, family upbringing, effort and sustainable development, the importance of preserving records and identifying property, as well as the management and advancement of property, among others. What is important for the reader of this article to understand is that intertextuality cannot be identified in a text if the analyst lacks background knowledge or familiarity with the knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in various preceding texts. Therefore, a person who can identify intertextuality in artistic works must be a highly knowledgeable and inquisitive individual, someone with a thirst and hunger for knowledge, techniques, skills, and the characteristic curiosity gained through exploring various creative works and a range of academic writings. On the contrary, a reader will not be able to discern the intertextuality within the creative work they are reading if they do not mentally perceive the resonances of knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in earlier works. The play is rich in various artistic and theoretical experiments and techniques. For example, within the play, there is intertextuality as each chapter is given a subtopic that refers to linguistic terms from the field of structural linguistics, in order to illustrate the birth and development of the subject matter being discussed by the author. In this book, these scholars explain that, typically, the human brain has an area responsible for recording, storing, and rapidly retrieving memories of events and experiences a person has encountered. Therefore, when a reader comes across an event or technique that they have previously encountered in another work, their mind immediately responds and triggers a sensation that draws on the recall of that event or technique. The retrieval of a previous event, matter, or technique in relation to what has just been encountered produces an intersection of two texts. This intersection creates a resonance of the event, technique, or matter within the reader’s mind. All of these processes occur very rapidly. Therefore, you cannot recognize the presence of intertextuality if you are not a keen reader or a careful follower of different matters and various writings—both extensively and in depth. Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory. Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Therefore, in terms of character and stance, these characters remain unchanged from the beginning to the end of the play. Mlacha and Madumulla (1991) describe such characters as ones who do not appear to grow in character, actions, or psychologically. The main goal of this approach is to persuade the public to embrace good deeds and names that embody goodness, so as to reject evil and oppose the use of names that carry negative meanings, since African societies believe that a name shapes the character of the individual. An echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced, such as when a person shouts inside a cave or forest, while philosophy refers to the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Therefore, a philosophical echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced through the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence. The play "Our Unity, Our Triumph" portrays a woman enduring intense and painful struggles for liberation. The play shows how the woman finds herself on the verge of despair, almost accepting defeat, but with the support of a large community that joins her, she ultimately emerges victorious. This is a philosophical echo that reminds us of the saying that one finger cannot kill a louse and that unity is always victory. According to the Standard Swahili Dictionary (TUKI, 2013), the word “word” is defined as a group of sounds that are spoken or written together to convey meaning. And so, when words are grouped into different units that have not yet reached the status of a clause or a sentence, they are called phrases (Kipacha, 2005). Therefore, a word and another word form a phrase. Likewise, when phrases are brought together, they form clauses. Massamba (2004) defines a clause as "a construction with a subject and a predicate that exists within a main construction." Several clauses combine to form a sentence; and when several sentences are brought together, they form a construction, which then forms a paragraph, and paragraphs in turn produce an essay. A sentence is a self-contained construction that essentially involves an action and an agent (TUKI, 2013). Kanuni hizi ni: (i) si rahisi na kwa hakika haiwezekani kutazama maandishi kama bidhaa ambayo ni yatima, katika upekee wake na katika hali ya pekee; badala yake, lazima tutambue kwamba kuna maandishi yaliyotangulia ambayo yanahusiana na maandishi mapya; (ii) maandishi huingiliana na kuathiriana, hivyo kudhani kwamba maandishi ya fasihi yanajitosheleza na ni huru ni kujifanya huoni; na (iii) maandishi ya kisanii hualika mitindo fulani ya uwasilishaji na misimbo mahususi ambayo husaidia kuashiria wazo, tukio, kazi, au kazi nyingine itakayofuata—hivyo kuleta athari kwenye kazi ya ubunifu inayofuata (Kristeva, 1980). Kwa kufuata kanuni hizi, tunaweza kusema kuwa muingiliano wa maandishi ni nadharia na ujuzi wa kitaaluma unaochunguza, unatambua, na kueleza uhusiano uliopo kati ya maandishi moja na jingine, ili kubaini athari za moja kwa moja au zisizo za moja kwa moja (kuakisi) zinazosababishwa na mwingiliano na uimarishaji wa pande mbili wa maandishi haya. Kwa maneno mengine, nadharia ya muingiliano wa maandishi ni mwongozo wa kuchanganua kazi za sanaa, kwa kuzingatia maandishi ya fasihi, ili kubaini uwepo wa uazimaji au mazungumzo; yaani, kufanana kwa mtindo, dhamira, na mbinu kati ya maandishi moja na jingine. Uchambuzi uliendeshwa kwa kuongozwa na nadharia ya Muingiliano wa maandishi. Nadharia hii ilitokana na mawazo ya kidialogi ya mwanazuoni wa Kirusi, Mikhail Bakhtin (alizaliwa 1895, alifariki 1975), na baadaye ikaboreshwa na mwanausemi wa Kifaransa, Julia Kristeva (Wamitila, 2002; Wafula na Njogu, 2007). Hapa ni sahihi kusema kwamba Julia Kristeva ndiye muasisi wa nadharia ya Uandani baada ya kuboresha nadharia ya Majadiliano ya Mikhail Bakhtin katika miaka ya 1960. Bakhtin anatuonyesha kwamba kazi yoyote ya fasihi ina utofauti wa sauti. Uhusiano huu wa maandishi, kwa maneno mengine, pia unaitwa mwangwi. waliotengwa; hasa wanawake na watoto. Tamthilia hii inatathmini athari hizi na kisha inapendekeza jinsi ukombozi wa kiakili, kitamaduni, na kijamii unavyopaswa kukuza umoja na ushirikiano ndani ya jamii kubwa ili kuwasaidia walionyimwa haki wapate ukombozi binafsi. Tamthilia hii inatumia lugha ambayo inaeleweka haraka na kwa urahisi na mtu yeyote aliye na ujuzi wa Kiswahili. Mazungumzo yaliyoundwa katika tamthilia hii yanachochea mada mbalimbali kama vile ukombozi, nafasi ya wanawake katika jamii, tabaka za kijamii, hujuma, ubinafsi, fitina, ukandamizaji, chuki, wivu, tamaa, usaliti, unyonyaji, matumizi mabaya, ubaguzi, uwazi na ukweli, desturi na mila, umoja na mshikamano, malezi ya familia, jitihada na maendeleo endelevu, umuhimu wa kuhifadhi kumbukumbu na utambuzi wa mali, pamoja na usimamizi na uendelezaji wa mali, miongoni mwa mengine. Kilicho muhimu kwa msomaji wa makala hii kuelewa ni kwamba mwingiliano wa maandishi hauwezi kutambuliwa katika maandishi ikiwa mchambuzi anakosa maarifa ya awali au ufahamu wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na tabia zinazopatikana katika maandishi mbalimbali yaliyotangulia. Kwa hiyo, mtu anayeweza kutambua mwingiliano wa maandishi katika kazi za sanaa lazima awe mtu mwenye maarifa mengi na mwenye hamu ya kujifunza, mtu mwenye kiu na njaa ya maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na udadisi ambao hupatikana kwa kuchunguza kazi mbalimbali za ubunifu na maandishi ya kiakademia. Kinyume chake, msomaji hataweza kutambua mwingiliano wa maandishi katika kazi ya ubunifu anayosoma ikiwa hatambui kiakili muingiliano wa maarifa, mbinu, ujuzi, na sifa zilizopatikana katika kazi za awali. Tamthilia ina utajiri wa majaribio na mbinu mbalimbali za kisanii na nadharia. Kwa mfano, ndani ya tamthilia, kuna mlinganisho wa maandishi kwani kila sura imepewa mada ndogo inayorejelea istilahi za kiisimu kutoka katika taaluma ya isimu umbo, ili kuonyesha kuzaliwa na kukua kwa mada inayojadiliwa na mwandishi. Aina nyingine ya uinterteksti hupatikana katika matumizi ya michoro na picha, mbinu za uhadithi, na upanuzi usio wa kawaida wa maelekezo ya jukwaani, pamoja na kuingiza dansi, nyimbo, muziki, mashairi, majigambo, mashairi ya kikundi, na uwasilishaji wa Joka (Mgimba, 2017). Zaidi ya hayo, hata uchaguzi wa jina "Sumukuvu," ambalo linaakisi tabia na matendo yanayoashiria sifa za kitu au kiumbe fulani, unaonyesha upande mwingine wa kazi hiyo: uwepo wa sifa za kawaida za wahusika katika fasihi simulizi. Kwa mfano, mhusika Sumukuvu anaweza kuonekana kama mhusika wa kibinadamu mwenye jina linalofanana na sumu au kama mhusika wa fasihi simulizi aliyefanyiwa擬anthropomorphism na kupewa uhai, kisha akatenda kama binadamu. Sababu hii inalingana na kile kinachoelezwa kwa kina na Taylor na Taylor (1983) katika kitabu chao maarufu The Psychology of Reading. Katika kitabu hiki, wataalamu hawa wanaeleza kuwa, kawaida, ubongo wa binadamu una eneo maalum linalohusika na kurekodi, kuhifadhi na kukumbuka kwa haraka kumbukumbu za matukio na uzoefu ambao mtu amewahi kupitia. Hivyo basi, msomaji anapokutana na tukio au mbinu ambayo tayari amewahi kuikuta katika kazi nyingine, akili yake hupokea taarifa hiyo mara moja na husababisha hisia inayotokana na kukumbuka tukio au mbinu hiyo. Kukumbuka tukio, jambo, au mbinu ya awali kwa uhusiano na kile ambacho msomaji amekutana nacho sasa hivi kunaleta muingiliano wa maandishi mawili. Mwingiliano huu husababisha matukio, mbinu au mambo hayo "yaingurume" kwenye akili ya msomaji. Mchakato huu mzima hutokea haraka sana. Kwa hiyo, huwezi kutambua uwepo wa maingiliano ya maandishi ikiwa wewe si msomaji makini au mfuatiliaji mwangalifu wa mambo mbalimbali na maandishi tofauti—kwa upana na kwa undani. Muhtasari wa tamthilia Ushikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu  
Ushikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni tamthilia ya Kiswahili yenye mwelekeo mkubwa wa kike, inayochanganua athari za tabia na vitendo vya baadhi ya wanajamii wanaoendeleza imani potofu, wivu, chuki, ubinafsi, pamoja na aina mbalimbali za unyanyasaji dhidi ya wengine.  
Katika sekta ya kilimo, sumukuvu (mycotoxin) inarejelea sumu au kemikali hatari zinazozalishwa na aina ya ukungu uitwao Kuvu, ambao hukua na kushambulia mimea ya chakula na mimea ya mafuta, hasa ile yenye majani na mbegu kama vile nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga, na malisho ya mifugo ama shambani au maghalani. Sumukuvu hauonekani kwa jicho la kawaida lakini unaweza kugunduliwa kwa kutumia vipimo maalum vya maabara. Aidha, mchezo huu unatambua picha kadhaa, ikiwa ni pamoja na joka, taa ya kijani, ukungu mzito, giza, na ajali. Aina nyingine ya utajiri hupatikana katika maonyesho mbalimbali, ikiwa ni pamoja na aina tofauti za tamathali za usemi kama vile vitendawili, misemo, methali, mafumbo, na sitiari. Vivyo hivyo, pamoja na huzuni, mwandishi ameunganisha ucheshi kama njia ya kuleta faraja na kurejesha amani iliyokuwa imepotea katika familia. KUHUSU MWANDISHI ANITHA ELIAS MGIMBA

Tamthilia yetu Umoja Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni kazi yake ya kwanza kuandika, kuchapisha, na kutoa sokoni. Hata uandishi wa tamthilia hii unatumia mbinu mbalimbali na unachota kutoka kwa ulimwengu mpana unaojumuisha maandishi ya kubuni, maandishi ya kijamii, mitazamo ya kifeministi, na uzoefu halisi unaotawala jamii zetu. Kwa hiyo, tunaweza kusema kwamba maisha ya kitawa na maisha ya kawaida ya jamii inayomzunguka Anitha yameungana katika umbo la tamthilia hii na kusababisha kuzaliwa kwa Umoja Wetu Ushindi Wetu. UCHANGAMANO WA MAANDISHI KATIKA UMOJA WETU, USHINDI WETU  
Uchambuzi uliofanywa kwenye tamthilia hii umeonyesha kuwa kuna uhusiano mkubwa wa maandishi kati ya maandishi mbalimbali ndani yake. Hata hivyo, kwa madhumuni ya makala hii, tutaonesha uhusiano wa maandishi unaohusiana na: maandiko kutoka vitabu vitakatifu, sitiari katika uteuzi na uundaji wa wahusika, athari za kifalsafa, majina ya sura au sehemu ya msuko wa hadithi, na hadithi za kimitholojia kuhusu alama, kama sehemu ya kuzingatia kikomo cha maneno kinachotakiwa na jarida hili. Alipata elimu yake ya juu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kikatoliki cha Mwenge mjini Moshi, Kilimanjaro (2014–2017), ambako alisoma na kuhitimu Shahada ya Elimu katika Sanaa, akibobea katika Historia na Kiswahili, bila kusahau somo la Uandishi wa Ubunifu. Kwa sasa anaendelea na masomo zaidi—Shahada ya Uzamili ya Elimu katika Utawala na Mipango katika Chuo Kikuu cha Mtakatifu Augustine, Mwanza, Tanzania. Mbali na masomo yake ya uzamili, Anitha ni mwalimu wa shule ya sekondari, akifundisha Historia na Kiswahili katika shule ya kongamano lake iitwayo St. John Paul II Iringa. Chakula anachokipenda zaidi ni ugali na samaki. Anapenda pia kuhudumia jamii kupitia kufundisha. Anitha ni mchezaji mahiri wa netiboli anayebobea katika nafasi ya ulinzi wa lango (GK), nafasi anayoifanya kwa ustadi mkubwa kiasi kwamba imeongeza umaarufu na sifa yake.

Huu ni ushahidi usioweza kupingika kwamba tamthilia hii haikuundwa bila msingi wowote, bali mwandishi alichota maarifa, ujuzi, na uzoefu kutoka katika maandiko takatifu ya dini iliyomlea na kumkuza, kama tulivyobainisha katika wasifu wa mwandishi. Nukuu zote tulizorejelea zinaakisi wazi sauti za maandiko ya awali, hivyo kuthibitisha kwa nguvu kwamba uandishi na utunzi haviwezi kutengwa na ushawishi wa maandiko yaliyotangulia au mazingira ya kimwili na kiroho yaliyomlea na kumjenga mwandishi. Ndiyo maana Worton na Still (1990) wanasisitiza kwamba kila maandishi ni nyongeza kwa maandishi mengine. Hakuna maandishi ambayo ni kamili na hayahitaji kuongezewa kutoka kwa maandishi mengine ili yawe na maana na yaeleweke. Hii inamaanisha kwamba hakuna maandishi yanayofanya kazi kama mfumo uliofungwa na kujitosheleza; badala yake, kila maandishi yanategemea maandishi yaliyotangulia. Aidha, athari hii ya mwingiliano wa maandishi inayotokana na kujifunza, kuishi kulingana na mafundisho ya dini, na kusoma vitabu vitakatifu haimhusu Anitha pekee, bali pia inapatikana katika kazi bunifu za waandishi maarufu kama Abdilatif Abdallah, Euphrase Kezilahabi, Mwanakupona Binti Mshamu, Sayyid Abdalla Bin Ali bin Nasir, Shaaban Robert, Sheikh Umar bin al-Ahdaly, kutaja wachache tu. Mwangwi ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kutolewa, kama vile mtu anapopiga kelele ndani ya pango au msitu, huku falsafa ikimaanisha uchunguzi wa asili, maana na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na tahadhari (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Hivyo basi, mwangwi wa kifalsafa ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kutolewa kupitia uchunguzi wa asili, maana na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na tahadhari. Tamthilia *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* inaonekana kupanga mkondo wake wa matukio kwa kutumia aina mbili za vichwa – vichwa vikuu na vichwa vidogo. Vichwa vikuu (na vichwa vidogo vilivyo kwenye mabano) vilivyotumika ni: Sehemu ya Kwanza (Neno), Sehemu ya Pili (Kipashio), Sehemu ya Tatu (Vibanjiko), Sehemu ya Nne (Sentensi), Sehemu ya Tano (Insha Fupi), Sehemu ya Sita (Aya), na Sehemu ya Saba (Insha). Tunapotazama maneno yaliyotumika kama vichwa vidogo kutambua maudhui, tunagundua kuwa maneno haya yametokana na taaluma ya Isimu – Mofolojia na Sarufi kama ilivyoelezwa na kujadiliwa na Massamba, Kihore, na Hokororo (2012), pamoja na kwenye taaluma ya ujuzi wa mawasiliano. Maneno haya si maneno ya kawaida tu bali ni dhana za kitaaluma ambazo zinarejelea vipengele vya msingi katika fani hizi mbili. Kilinguistiki, tunatambua kwamba haya ni istilahi zinazobeba maana za kitaalamu za neno husika, ingawa, hadi sasa, hakujawahi kuwepo na makubaliano juu ya maana au dhana hizi—"neno," "kifungu," "kishazi," "sentensi," "utunzi," "aya," na "insha" (Kipacha, 2005). Ingawa hakuna makubaliano, tunapaswa kukiri kwamba kuna maelezo ya kitaaluma yaliyotolewa na wasomi wa isimu. Kwa hiyo, kupitia maelezo haya, tutaweza kuona kama uteuzi wa istilahi hizi za kiisimu una mantiki ya muingiliano wa maandishi kati ya kazi ya fasihi bunifu na taaluma ya isimu. Katika muktadha huu, maudhui yaliyopatikana katika tamthilia *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* yamerahisisha sana ufafanuzi wa tamthilia *Nguzo Mama*, ambayo imetolewa kwa njia ya sitiari. Hii ni kusema kwamba, kuna majadiliano ya kifalsafa na kiwazo kati ya Anitha E. Mgimba na Penina Muhando kupitia mjadala wa kutafuta njia bora ya kuwakomboa wanawake. Mazungumzo hayo si kitu kingine bali ni falsafa kwamba kidole kimoja pekee hakiwezi kamwe kuponda chawa. Hii inamaanisha kwamba ukombozi wa kweli wa mwanamke hauwezi kupatikana kupitia juhudi zake binafsi pekee, bila kushirikiana na wanaume kuondoa minyororo inayowakandamiza wanawake katika nyanja zote za maisha ya binadamu. Ndiyo maana Anitha anahitimisha tamthilia yake kwa kusema, "[...]. Nakwambia mjomba, sitarudi tena! [...] Ninashukuru kwamba umoja wetu umenipa ushindi dhidi ya hila za wasambazaji wa sumu. Kweli, kidole kimoja hakiwezi kuua chawa.

Majina ya Sura / Majina ya Msingi wa Hadithi

Majina ya sura au majina ya msingi wa hadithi ni vichwa vya mada vilivyochaguliwa na mwandishi ili kutenganisha sehemu.

Kulingana na Kamusi Sanifu ya Kiswahili (TUKI, 2013), neno “neno” hufasiliwa kama kikundi cha sauti zinazotamkwa au kuandikwa pamoja ili kutoa maana. Kwa hivyo, maneno yanapopangwa katika vikundi mbalimbali ambavyo bado havijafikia hadhi ya kiima au sentensi, huitwa vikundi (Kipacha, 2005). Hivyo basi, neno na neno jingine huunda kirai. Vivyo hivyo, vikundi vinapounganishwa, huunda viima. Massamba (2004) anafafanua kishazi kama "muundo wenye kiima na kiarifu ambao upo ndani ya muundo mkuu." Vishazi kadhaa vinaungana kuunda sentensi; na sentensi kadhaa zinapokuja pamoja, zinaunda muundo, ambao kisha unaunda aya, na aya nazo huzalisha insha. Sentensi ni ujenzi unaojitegemea ambao kimsingi unahusisha kitendo na mtendaji (TUKI, 2013). Kamusi hii ya Kiswahili Sanifu (TUKI, 2013) inafafanua neno "tungo" kama kitengo cha muundo kinachotokana na mpangilio wa mawasiliano, mofolojia, na sintaksia, pamoja na mwelekeo unaolingana na taaluma fulani. Kama tulivyoona katika tamthilia za Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani, hili linathibitisha bila shaka mwingiliano wa maandishi katika uteuzi na utambuzi wa majina ya tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na taaluma ya isimu – mofolojia, na kati ya tamthilia ya Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu na tamthilia nyingine, kama vile Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani. Mytholojia ya Ishara pamoja na muunganiko wa vitengo rahisi ili kuunda kitengo kikubwa, na insha inafafanuliwa kama utunzi wa maneno katika mfumo wa nathari kuhusu mada fulani. Kutokana na maelezo haya, tunagundua kwamba neno (au maneno) huunda vishazi, na vishazi hivi huunda vikokotoo, na vikokotoo huunda sentensi, kisha sentensi huunda insha, insha huunda aya, na aya kadhaa zinaunda insha kamili. Kwa hiyo, tunachokiona hapa ni kwamba mwandishi amepanga matukio yake kutoka tukio dogo hadi tukio kubwa zaidi; yaani, alianza na jambo dogo lililosababisha jambo kubwa zaidi, ambalo lilipelekea jambo kubwa zaidi, kisha kubwa zaidi tena, na hatimaye kubwa zaidi ya yote, lililotokana na mkusanyiko wa mambo mengi. Hii ni makutano kati ya fasihi na taaluma ya isimu. Falsafa ya alama ni mtazamo wa kisanii unaotumia picha zinazoakisi hadithi za msingi za binadamu kuhusu imani zinazohusiana na nguvu za asili na/au uchawi. Mwandishi ametumia alama kadhaa zilizounganishwa na mitholojia, hasa mitholojia za Kiafrika. Moja ya alama zinazobeba mitholojia inayojulikana miongoni mwa jamii nyingi za Kiafrika na duniani kote ni nyoka mkubwa mweusi (Joka). Kulingana na Morris (katika Shanafelt, 2014), nyoka kama alama (hasa chatu) inahusishwa na mvua, maji, mlolongo wa kiikolojia, uzazi, na nguvu za kichawi/kidini, pamoja na kuwa ishara ya kifo na ufufuo. Fumbo lililoelezwa na msomi huyu kuhusu nyoka na maana zake pia linaonekana katika maandiko matakatifu, hasa katika Biblia Takatifu (Mwanzo 3:14-15, Mwanzo 44:5, Kutoka 7:8-12, Hesabu 21:6-9, 1 Yohana 3:8, Ufunuo 12:9, Ufunuo 12:17, Ufunuo 20:2,10). Hii ndiyo sababu nyoka, kama ishara, ana nguvu kubwa, ikitokana na tamaduni zinazoegemea imani katika jamii mbalimbali, siyo tu Afrika bali pia duniani kote (Hambly, 1929; Lynch na Roberts, 2010; Thomas, 2011; Shanafelt, 2014). Sio isimu pekee inayoonekana kugonga ndani ya tamthiliya hii, bali pia kuna aina nyingine ya mguso. Huu mlingano ni ufanano wa kimuundo kati ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* na tamthilia nyingine kadhaa za Kiswahili, kwa mfano, *Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe* (1988) ya Edwin Semzaba na *Nje – Ndani* (2016) ya A. A. Majid Mswahili na M. S. Njonjolo. Edwin Semzaba ametumia ujuzi kutoka katika taaluma ya Jiomorfolojia kuchagua na kuanzisha hadithi ili kuonyesha chanzo cha tatizo hadi athari zake. Utambuzi huu umetumia dhana zifuatazo kwa mpangilio: Mfereji mdogo – Matawimto – Mto – Mkondo – Hadi Baharini. Vivyo hivyo, A. A. Majid Mswahili na M. S. Njonjolo wametumia mbinu kutoka katika fani za afya na tiba kuchagua na kubaini mada zao ili kuangazia chanzo cha tatizo hadi athari zake. Walitumia mlolongo ufuatao wa dalili: Kichocheo cha Awali – Dalili ya Kwanza (Papule) – Dalili ya Pili (Papules) – Dalili ya Tatu (Noduli) – Dalili ya Nne (Jipu) – Dalili ya Tano (Majipu) – Dalili ya Sita (Vidonda). Ufafanuzi huu unatufanya tutambue kwamba matumizi ya joka, hasa nyoka wa kutisha, katika kazi za ubunifu si jambo jipya bali ni mwendelezo wa desturi ya kisanii ya kuchukua kutoka kwenye tamaduni za kijamii—mila—na kuzihusisha katika kazi mpya za ubunifu. Katika tamthilia Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu, mwandishi anaonyesha uhusiano kati ya ishara ya nyoka na maana yake kuhusiana na mitholojia. Hii ni kusema, nyoka mkubwa unatumiwa kimitolojia kufikisha taarifa kuhusu tukio linalokabili jamii husika. Hivyo basi, tamthilia Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu inaonyesha ushawishi wa ujuzi wa mawasiliano na taaluma za kiisimu—Morfolojia na Sintaksia—katika uteuzi na utambuzi wa majina ya njama zake. Aidha, tamthilia hii pia inaendesha mazungumzo ya kimitindo (kupitia uteuzi na utambuzi wa majina ya njama) na tamthilia za awali kama vile Ngoswe Penzi Kitovu cha Uzembe na Nje – Ndani. Mfanano huu, na uwepo wa miangwi kutoka kwa taaluma za ujuzi wa mawasiliano,

Ndoo inarudi nyuma kwa hofu na kuruka kutoka kichwani mwake. Caroline anachukua hatua ya kusita nyuma. Mungu wangu, hii ni nini! Mwili umekufa ganzi kwa hofu. (Anasimama na kutikisa kichwa huku akilalamika na kuzungumza na nafsi yake) Kulingana na tamaduni zetu, ukiona nyoka kama huyu, ni lazima jambo baya litokee kwenye familia au ukoo wa mtu huyo. Sijui...! Ni nini sasa, kweli? Tungoje, tutagundua. Johns: Ah! Leo, tulipokuwa tunaenda darasani, tuliiona nyoka mweusi sana akishuka kutoka kwenye mti ili kutufuata. Tulipiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa! Wanafunzi na walimu walikuja na mawe ili kumuua, lakini alitoweka—sijui alikimbilia wapi mwenyewe. Huyo mtu mkubwa! Hii ni nini leo! Ilikuwa saa ngapi? Kweli, ilikuwa takriban dakika moja baada ya kutuacha na kuondoka. Damiano: (Anawasoma haraka na kuhisi hisia zao) Msihofu kuhusu chochote, wapendwa wangu. Hicho ni kiumbe cha Mungu kama sisi. Katika pori, wanahifadhiwa mateka na watu wanalipa pesa nyingi kuwaona. Natambua kwamba barani Afrika, baadhi ya jamii huona nyoka mkubwa mweusi kama baraka katika maisha yao, wakati wengine wanafikiri ni ishara mbaya. Mke wangu mpendwa, tafadhali usifikirie kama ishara mbaya kabisa; badala yake, fikiria kuwa kuna baraka mbele yetu. Niruhusu niende nikachukue gari kwa sababu fundi alisema amemaliza kulifanyia kazi. Caroline: (Kwa upole) Sawa mpenzi, lakini tafadhali rudi mapema. Damiano: (Kwa tabasamu) Nitarudi sasa hivi, mpenzi wangu. M-mwa-a-a-a…

[…] Dakika kumi zimepita tangu Damiano aondoke nyumbani. Akiwa ndani ya zizi la ng'ombe, Johns anasikia fujo kwa mbali—“u-uwi-wi-wi, ajali…!” Ajali, kila mtu! Ajali, kila mtu, njoo msaidie—ee-ee-e.” Anang'aza mwanga barabarani lakini hawezi kuona vizuri na hawezi kwenda pale bila ruhusa ya mama yake. Kwa hivyo anakimbia ndani kumjulisha mama yake. Johns: (Kwa sauti kubwa). Mama! Mama! Ninasikia watu wakipiga kelele barabarani wakisema kumetokea ajali! Ajali! Ajali! Caroline: (Anasimama). Je, kuna mtu yeyote ambaye amepata nafuu kweli? (Anaufunga kanga yake vizuri na haraka anatoka nje). Madereva hawa wa mabasi wanaoendesha kwa kasi bila uangalifu watatuangamiza kweli! Jirani: (Anakutana na Caroline nje ya lango na kushika mkono wake). Mama Johns, tafadhali rudi ndani kwa muda kidogo. Jiandae… tayari ameshapelekwa hospitalini kwa haraka… harakisha. Caroline: (Anaonekana amechanganyikiwa) Usiniambie ni Damiano wangu, eh! Si hivyo? Jirani: (Hajibu. Anamkamata Caroline kwa nguvu na kumvuta kumrudisha ndani). Caroline: (Anaonekana akichanganyikiwa zaidi na zaidi). Je, amekufa au amevunjika kidole tu? Niambie basi, tafadhali,
au niende nijionee mwenyewe? Mungu wangu, mume wangu…! Jirani: (Hajibu. Bado anamkumbatia Caroline kwa nguvu.) Machozi yanatiririka usoni mwake. Wameingia ndani. Anaonekana akifunga milango ya nje ya nyumba ya Damiano. Mara anaanza kupiga simu hapa na pale. Wakati huo huo, Caroline tayari ameingia chumbani, akifuatwa na watoto wake. Caroline: (Anatoka chumbani akiwa amevaa gauni refu.) Kikoi alikuwa ameuvua kichwani badala ya begani. Yeye hajaelewa kabisa mwenyewe) Niko tayari, jirani, twende. Watoto wangu wabarikiwa, niruhusuni niende nikamwone baba yenu. Ajali hiyo ilikuwa yeye. Hakikisha, hakuumia vibaya. Ninasikia ameparuza tu kucha (Watoto wanajibu kwa wasiwasi, hawaiamini maneno ya mama yao). Wanamgeukia Jirani, ambaye amesimama na kumkaribia Caroline). Jirani: (Anaweka mkono kwenye bega la Caroline na kunong’ona sikioni mwake) Hakuna haja ya kwenda hospitalini, Mama Johns! Ajali hiyo ilikuwa mbaya sana. Lori imemponda hadi kufa... Tumenukuu tukio hili kwa urefu ili kutoa picha kamili ya jinsi nyoka mkubwa alivyotokea miongoni mwa wanafamilia wa Damiano na kile kilichofuata baadaye. Inageuka kuwa kuonekana kwa nyoka mkubwa mweusi kwenye familia ya Damiano kulikuwa ishara — onyo la kifo — kama Caroline alivyoeleza: “[…] Kulingana na desturi zetu, ukiona nyoka wa aina hii, lazima kitu kibaya kitokee kwenye familia au ukoo huo.” Sijui...! Ni nini sasa, kweli? "Tusubiri; tutasikia habari zake." Zaidi ya hayo, nyoka alionyesha uwepo wa nguvu za kichawi ambazo zinaweza kuleta madhara kwa familia au ukoo. Kama Morris (katika Shanafelt, 2014) alivyosema, nguvu za kichawi zinaweza kutumia nyoka kama mojawapo ya alama za kiutamaduni. Ushahidi wa nyoka kuashiria uwepo wa nguvu za kichawi unapatikana katika nukuu hii:  
Kupitia nukuu hizi, tunaona kwamba tamthilia *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* ina vipengele vya kimfumo vya ushairi vinavyoakisi hadithi za zamani za Waafrika pamoja na jamii nyingine nje ya bara la Afrika. Zaidi ya hayo, matumizi ya nyoka kama ishara ya kisanii hayajaishia kwenye tamthilia hii pekee bali yanaonekana pia katika kazi nyingine za ubunifu za Kiswahili. Fasihi simulizi, kama sanaa ya kale, mara nyingi hutumia nyoka wakubwa na viumbe wengine kuwakilisha Mungu, miungu, roho, binadamu, au dhana fulani kupitia taswira. Kwa hiyo, taswira ya viumbe kama nyoka wakubwa ni sehemu ya utajiri unaobebwa katika simulizi za jadi, jambo ambalo pia tunaliona katika fasihi ya jadi ya simulizi na andishi (Bertoncini, 1989; Madumulla, 2009). Baadhi ya kazi za kubuni zinazojumuisha matumizi ya nyoka mkubwa kwa njia ya kimajazi na kimaana, ambazo tunaweza kuhusisha na tamthilia ya *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu*, ni pamoja na: *Adili na Nduguze* (Robert, 1952), *Mtu Maarufu Katika Historia ya Usukuma* (Boaz, 1974), *Ngao ya Jadi* (Hussein, 1976), *Shujaa Gishegu* (Masatu, bila mwaka), *Nondo Mlaji wa Watu*, *Nunda Mlaji wa Watu na Hadithi Nyingine* (Hellier, 1964), *Ngoma ya Ng’wanamalundi* (Mbogo, 1988), na *Ngozi ya Nyoka* (Kezilahabi, 2006). Katika kazi hizi zote, matumizi ya nyoka mkubwa hubeba kipengele cha maajabu ya kimiujiza, kikiashiria, miongoni mwa mambo mengine, utajiri, kifo, ulinzi na usalama, uponyaji na afya, uchawi, uzazi, ukandamizaji, mateso, na mamlaka. Kazi hizi ni za zamani kuliko tamthilia tuliyochunguza. Imani yetu ni kwamba, kwa kuwa mwandishi alisoma kazi za kubuniwa za waandishi na mitindo mbalimbali katika kozi hiyo [...] Vijana waliomkimbiza mwili hospitalini wanafika. Kauli yao inavunja mioyo ya waombolezaji. Damiano si mwili tena bali vipande vya nyama na mfupa tu [...]. Jeneza iliyobeba mwili wa marehemu Damiano inaleta ndani ya nyumba aliyojenga. Wazee wanaomba faragha kidogo ili kukamilisha mila za jadi kulingana na desturi zao. Baada ya dakika chache, wanatoka wakiwa na mioyo mizito, ishara ya kifo kisicho cha kawaida kulingana na utamaduni wao. Hisia zao zimefichua kila kitu, lakini hawataki kuona umwagaji mwingine wa damu. Wanaagiza kwamba mwili utolewe nje na kuagwa haraka kabla ya jua kutua. (uk. 14-15). discourses.source_txt: Intertextuality is a method, skill, or discipline and a guide for the scientific analysis of texts, especially artistic and non-artistic works, to determine the presence of influence through borrowing or dialogue; that is, the similarity in form, content, and technique between one text and another. This resemblance can be direct or involve proximity. Such interaction is also referred to as an echo.

THEORETICAL FRAMEWORK  
These principles are: (i) it is not easy and indeed impossible to view a text as a product that is an orphan, in its own uniqueness and in isolation; instead, we must recognize that there are preceding texts that are related to the new text; (ii) texts interact and influence each other, so to think that a literary text is self-sufficient and independent is willful blindness; and (iii) an artistic text invites certain modes of expression and specific codes which help to signal an idea, event, work, or another subsequent work—thereby creating an impact on the creative work that follows (Kristeva, 1980). Based on these principles, we can say that intertextuality is a theory and academic skill that examines, identifies, and explains the relationships that exist between one text and another, in order to determine the direct or indirect (echoed) effects resulting from the interactions and mutual reinforcement of these texts. In other words, the theory of intertextuality is a guide for analyzing works of art, with a focus on literary texts, to determine the existence of borrowing or dialogue; that is, resemblance in genre, theme, and technique between one text and another. discourses.source_txt: What is important for the reader of this article to understand is that intertextuality cannot be identified in a text if the analyst lacks background knowledge or familiarity with the knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in various preceding texts. Therefore, a person who can identify intertextuality in artistic works must be a highly knowledgeable and inquisitive individual, someone with a thirst and hunger for knowledge, techniques, skills, and the characteristic curiosity gained through exploring various creative works and a range of academic writings. On the contrary, a reader will not be able to discern the intertextuality within the creative work they are reading if they do not mentally perceive the resonances of knowledge, techniques, skills, and traits found in earlier works.

discourses.source_txt: This reason is consistent with what is thoroughly explained by Taylor and Taylor (1983) in their well-known book The Psychology of Reading. In this book, these scholars explain that, typically, the human brain has an area responsible for recording, storing, and rapidly retrieving memories of events and experiences a person has encountered. Therefore, when a reader comes across an event or technique that they have previously encountered in another work, their mind immediately responds and triggers a sensation that draws on the recall of that event or technique. The retrieval of a previous event, matter, or technique in relation to what has just been encountered produces an intersection of two texts. This intersection creates a resonance of the event, technique, or matter within the reader’s mind. All of these processes occur very rapidly.
discourses.translated_txt: Sababu hii inalingana na kile kinachoelezwa kwa kina na Taylor na Taylor (1983) katika kitabu chao maarufu The Psychology of Reading. Hivyo basi, msomaji anapokutana na tukio au mbinu ambayo tayari amewahi kuikuta katika kazi nyingine, akili yake hupokea taarifa hiyo mara moja na husababisha hisia inayotokana na kukumbuka tukio au mbinu hiyo. discourses.source_txt:
SUMMARY OF THE PLAY OUR COHESION OUR TRIUMPH  
Our Cohesion Our Triumph is a Swahili play with a strong feminist orientation, synthesizing the effects of the behaviors and actions of certain members of society who perpetuate misguided beliefs, envy, hatred, selfishness, and various forms of abuse toward others.  
In the agricultural sector, Sumukuvu (mycotoxin) refers to a poison or toxic chemicals produced by a type of fungus known as Kuvu, which grows and frequently attacks food crops and oil-yielding plants, especially those with leaves and seeds, notably cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal feeds either on the farm or in storage.
discourses.translated_txt:
Muhtasari wa tamthilia Ushikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu  
Ushikamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu ni tamthilia ya Kiswahili yenye mwelekeo mkubwa wa kike, inayochanganua athari za tabia na vitendo vya baadhi ya wanajamii wanaoendeleza imani potofu, wivu, chuki, ubinafsi, pamoja na aina mbalimbali za unyanyasaji dhidi ya wengine.  
Katika sekta ya kilimo, sumukuvu (mycotoxin) inarejelea sumu au kemikali hatari zinazozalishwa na aina ya ukungu uitwao Kuvu, ambao hukua na kushambulia mimea ya chakula na mimea ya mafuta, hasa ile yenye majani na mbegu kama vile nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga, na malisho ya mifugo ama shambani au maghalani.

discourses.source_txt: This is irrefutable evidence that the ideas and foundations of Mikhail Bakhtin and Julia Kristeva are not merely speculative but are concrete and scientifically valid, because (i) it is neither easy nor possible to regard a text as a unique product, in its singularity and in isolation; instead, there must be preceding texts related to the new text; (ii) texts interact and influence each other, therefore to think that a literary text is self-sufficient and independent is erroneous; (iii) an artistic text invites certain stylistic forms of expression and particular codes that help signify an idea, event, work, or subsequent works.

discourses.source_txt: This is indisputable evidence that this play was not created out of thin air, but rather the writer drew knowledge, skills, and experience from the sacred writings of the religion that raised and nurtured him, as we noted in the writer’s biography. All the quotations we referenced clearly reflect the echoes of earlier texts, thus strongly confirming that composition and writing cannot be divorced from the influence of preceding texts or the physical and spiritual environments that raised and shaped the writer.

discourses.source_txt: Allegory is an artistic device used by a writer to choose a name that reflects the character, behavior, and experiences of a character in the work they are creating. For example, a writer may name their character “Hasidi” (The Envious One). To justify this name, the writer must develop that character to act with envy from beginning to end. The selection and creation of characters whose traits align with their names is the artistic technique known as allegory.
discourses.translated_txt: Aligori ni mbinu ya kisanii inayotumiwa na mwandishi kuchagua jina linaloakisi tabia, mienendo, na uzoefu wa mhusika katika kazi anayoitunga. Kwa mfano, mwandishi anaweza kumpa mhusika wake jina "Hasidi" (Mwenye Wivu). Ili kuthibitisha jina hili, mwandishi lazima amjenge mhusika huyo aonyeshe wivu kuanzia mwanzo hadi mwisho. Uchaguzi na uundaji wa wahusika ambao sifa zao zinaendana na majina yao ndicho kinachoitwa mbinu ya kisanii ya aligori.

discourses.source_txt: Normally, these characters possess the traits of flat characters (those who do not undergo changes in character) in order to justify their names, because if they were to change in character, their names would no longer correspond to their new traits. Mlacha and Madumulla (1991) describe such characters as ones who do not appear to grow in character, actions, or psychologically.

discourses.source_txt: In the agricultural sector, a mycotoxin is a poison or toxic chemical produced by certain types of fungi known as molds, which primarily infest and attack food and oil crops derived from leafy plants and seeds, especially cereals, legumes, roots, groundnuts, and animal fodder, either in the field or in storage facilities.
discourses.translated_txt: Katika sekta ya kilimo, mycotoxin ni sumu au kemikali hatari inayozalishwa na aina fulani za kuvu zijulikanazo kama ukungu, ambazo huathiri na kushambulia mazao ya chakula na mafuta yanayotokana na mimea ya majani na mbegu, hasa nafaka, kunde, mizizi, karanga, na malisho ya wanyama, ama shambani au kwenye maghala ya kuhifadhi.

discourses.source_txt: Mycotoxin cannot be seen with the naked eye but is detected through special laboratory tests. Indicators of the presence of mycotoxin in a crop include the affected crop (seed) appearing rotten or having a color different from its original one.

discourses.source_txt: This quotation confirms the existence of intertextuality between the play Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu and the academic field of agriculture. Philosophical and Conceptual Echo

An echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced, such as when a person shouts inside a cave or forest, while philosophy refers to the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Therefore, a philosophical echo is a sound that is repeated after being produced through the study of the nature, meaning, and reasons for things, as well as wisdom and prudence.

Mwangwi wa Kifalsafa na Kifkira

Mwangwi ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kutolewa, kama vile mtu anapopiga kelele ndani ya pango au msitu, huku falsafa ikimaanisha uchunguzi wa asili, maana na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na tahadhari (Kamusi ya Kiswahili Sanifu, 2013). Hivyo basi, mwangwi wa kifalsafa ni sauti inayorudiwa baada ya kutolewa kupitia uchunguzi wa asili, maana na sababu za mambo, pamoja na hekima na tahadhari.

discourses.source_txt: The title serves as the identifier of the chapter or scenes within a written play. The play *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu* appears to organize its plot using two types of titles – main and sub-titles.

discourses.source_txt: The main titles (and sub-titles in brackets) used are: Part One (Word), Part Two (Phrase), Part Three (Clauses), Part Four (Sentence), Part Five (Composition), Part Six (Paragraph), and Part Seven (Essay). discourses.source_txt: Some of the imaginative works featuring the use of the large snake both symbolically and in meaning, which we can associate with the play *Utangamano Wetu Ushindi Wetu*, include: *Adili and His Brothers* (Robert, 1952), *A Famous Person in the History of Usukuma* (Boaz, 1974), *Traditional Shield* (Hussein, 1976), *Hero Gishegu* (Masatu, no year), *The Man-Eating Nondo*, *The Man-Eating Nunda and Other Stories* (Hellier, 1964), *The Dance of Ng’wanamalundi* (Mbogo, 1988), and *The Snake’s Skin* (Kezilahabi, 2006).
